messages:
maya: Hey @aj — customer reported tool calls failing after we rolled back a rename. They get 404s when invoking `tools.generate_pdf` but the registry shows `tools.Generate_PDF` and the alias `generate-pdf` exists. Can you take a quick look?

aj: On it. What do they see in the API error payload?

sam-customer: fyi: here's the exact error from our client: `{\n  \"error\": \"tool_not_found\",\n  \"message\": \"No tool named 'generate_pdf' found\"\n}` — we didn't change our call between yesterday and today.

maya: Thanks. Looks like a casing/underscore/dash mismatch. We recently backfilled a rename from `Generate_PDF` -> `generate-pdf` but the backfill job failed midway. Registry shows mixed entries.

aj: Pinging registry logs. @deploy-bot can you dump the tool-index snapshot for the region?

deploy-bot: /dump-tool-index region=us-west-2 job=on-demand -> attached snapshot id=ti-18625-01 (uploaded) :white_check_mark:

jordan: I see two entries for the same UUID: `uuid-77a` -> `Generate_PDF` and `uuid-77a` -> `generate-pdf` (different canonical names), plus an alias `generate_pdf` was added by a previous compatibility shim. Looks like the alias sync worker skipped the case-normalization step.

aj: Repro: calling the hosted API with `tool: \"generate_pdf\"` returns 404, but `tool: \"Generate_PDF\"` returns 200 on the node that still has the old cache. So cache divergence across nodes.

maya: Customer is on Dedicated, same symptoms. They tried toggling between `generate-pdf` and `generate_pdf` — both failing for them. We need a quick mitigation and a fix plan.

aj: Short-term mitigation: enable alias fallback that does case-insensitive lookup and underscore/dash normalization in the gateway for 30m while we fix the backfill. I'll push a config change to roll out to all gateway instances in us-west-2.

jordan: Rolling out now. Command we used:`

```
# enable compatibility fallback
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/feature-flags \
  -d '{"flag":"tool-name-normalize-fallback","state":"on","scope":"us-west-2"}'
```

aj: Patch applied to 3/3 gateways. Monitoring for errors.

maya: Noted. Can you also run a backfill repair for the registry? The job should reconcile canonical names, aliases, and clear stale per-node caches.

jordan: Will run a repair job with dry-run first. Steps: 1) fetch current registry rows for affected UUIDs 2) compute canonical name (lowercase, replace [_] with -) 3) write canonical name if mismatch 4) publish change to pubsub for cache invalidation.

jordan: Dry-run output snippet: `changed=24, unchanged=134, conflicts=2 (case-only)` — conflicts are the ones we need manual resolution for.

aj: Which conflicts?

jordan: Two UUIDs where there are concurrent writes: one row has `Generate_PDF` and another has `generate-pdf` with different created_at. I'll attach the reconciliation diff to the ticket.

maya: Customer wants repro steps to show they're not the cause. Can we provide a curl they can run to demonstrate mismatch?

aj: Sure — ask them to run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/call -d '{"tool":"generate_pdf","args":{}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -i` and capture response. That will show 404 before our gateway fallback, and 200 after.

sam-customer: Running now... got 404 originally. Watching for your change.

aj: Gateway fallback is active. Try again.

sam-customer: Ok retried — now it's 200. :tada: Thanks.

maya: Great, keep monitoring. jordan — after repair, please run a per-node cache purge: publish invalidation to `tool-registry-invalidate` topic for affected UUIDs.

jordan: Repair job scheduled; will run reconcile + publish + edge cache purge. Estimated 12 min.

jordan: Done — repair run completed. Published 28 invalidations.

aj: Confirmed all gateways now return 200 for `generate_pdf`, `generate-pdf`, and `Generate_PDF`. Also removed the temporary fallback flag.

maya: Customer update posted. Sam — we've fixed the inconsistent registry state and cleared caches. You can resume normal calls. We're opening a follow-up to add stronger invariants to the backfill worker and alerts for case-only duplicates.

sam-customer: Appreciate the fast help. Please leave the ticket open until follow-up items are complete.

maya: Will do. Creating ticket RDW-7891 to track backfill robustness and a test to prevent case-only duplicates.

aj: Notes for postmortem: root cause = partial backfill/rename job + missing normalization check in alias sync worker -> cache divergence across nodes -> 404s for callers using different name variants. Fix = gateway compatibility fallback (temporary), registry repair/backfill, cache invalidations, add alerts and stronger name normalization.

maya: Closing thread once RDW-7891 is created. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
